decisions.reason: The source changes only Big Block prize parameters; the independent Small Block winner, prize, and draw rules remain unchanged.
Changing the Big Block prize amount and draw interval does not alter which tickets are eligible or their post-draw reset behavior.
The source does not change the manual prize-claim payout mode.
The source does not change the recipient or the number of Small Block or Big Block tickets issued for a referral mint.
The Big Block remains active, so its ticket counter and the existing metadata visibility requirements remain valid unchanged.
The source changes Big Block prize parameters but does not change the referral commission amount or automatic distribution.
The source does not change no-referral ticket quantity or recipient selection.
Revising the Big Block amount and draw interval does not change the VRF winner-selection mechanism.
The source does not change unauthenticated API access or require removal of public pool-value information.
Badge selection, icons, and presentation are unrelated to the revised Big Block prize parameters.
The source does not change secondary royalty enforcement.
The Big Block parameter revision does not change email authentication or dashboard access.
